Objective

Create new business and sustain value

Develop joint offers, pursue third-market opportunities, and support succession or renewal.

Services for this objective

Select an offering to see what it involves.

  • Develop new offers together

    Combine Japanese and Indian capabilities to shape and test a new product, service or business opportunity.

    4 offerings

    • Search for complementary partners
      What we do
      Find firms whose capabilities could complete your business idea.
      What you receive
      Qualified candidates and introductions.
      Why this matters
      Find potential partners relevant to the opportunity.

      Directly related experience

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • Japanese and Indian firms designing a new offer together

    • Assess a proposed combination
      What we do
      Test customer value and the potential benefit to both firms.
      What you receive
      An assessment of the proposed combination.
      Why this matters
      Decide whether developing it further is worthwhile.

      Directly related experience

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • Japanese and Indian firms designing a new offer together

      Discuss this offering

    • Joint offer design and validation
      What we do
      Shape the offer with both partners and test customer response.
      What you receive
      A designed offer and assessment of customer feedback.
      Why this matters
      Build around what prospective buyers need.

      Directly related experience

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

    • Joint development arrangements
      What we do
      Support discussions on contributions, rights, revenue sharing and governance.
      What you receive
      Proposed development terms, agreed if the partners proceed.

  • Pursue customers in other markets together

    Bring complementary businesses together around an identified customer or project outside Japan and India, and develop their combined offer.

    4 offerings

    • Third-market opportunity assessment
      What we do
      Identify a buyer or project and assess its requirements.
      What you receive
      An assessed opportunity.
      Why this matters
      Focus on a specific target rather than a general ambition.

      Directly related experience

      What we do

  • Plan for succession and renewal

    Explore options for business continuity, find potential successors or partners, and plan the transition with appropriate specialists.

    4 offerings

    • Continuity options assessment
      What we do
      Examine options such as succession, partnership, sale or renewal.
      What you receive
      An assessment of realistic choices.
      Why this matters
      Decide which paths merit further exploration.

      Directly related experience

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • A specialist business considering succession

      Discuss this offering

    • Successor and partner search
      What we do
      Identify and approach potential owners or partners in either country.
      What you receive
      Qualified candidates and their stated interest.
      Why this matters
      Explore options beyond a domestic search.

      Directly related experience

      Our team’s individual experience

      • Negotiating an ownership transition for a software business

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • A specialist business considering succession

      Discuss this offering

    • Transition planning
      What we do
      Coordinate planning with transaction, legal and tax specialists.
      What you receive
      A transition plan.
      Why this matters
      Prepare an orderly process.

      Directly related experience

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      Discuss this offering

    • Post-transition integration support
      What we do
      Support the combined or renewed business through its early period.
      What you receive
      An integration plan and agreed support.
      Why this matters
      Help protect business value through the transition.

      Directly related experience

      Discuss this offering
